q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs **$4 per month**. If you choose annual billing, you save 20%. It includes unlimited notes and up to 3 devices.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The **Team plan** costs **$8 per user per month**, so for 5 users that would be **$40 per month**. You can also save 20% by choosing annual billing, which would bring it down to **$32 per month** for the team.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the Free plan, you can keep up to **100 notes** on **1 device**. If you need more, the Plus plan ($4/month) offers unlimited notes on up to 3 devices.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: There is no Linux desktop app, but Linux users can use Example Notes through any modern web browser via the web app. Please note that the web app does require an internet connection and does not work offline.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Unfortunately, Android 11 is not supported. Example Notes requires **Android 12 or later**. If you have further questions, feel free to ask!

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Unfortunately, no. The web app requires an internet connection. The mobile and desktop apps, however, work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to **Settings > Export** and choose **PDF** as the format. All your notes will be exported and emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: No worries! Deleted notes stay in your Trash for 30 days. Just open **Trash**, select the note, and click **"Restore"** to get it back.

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS is not supported for two-factor authentication. Example Notes only supports authenticator apps. You can enable this by going to **Settings > Security > Two-factor authentication**.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum file size for attachments on the Free plan is **25 MB per file**.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No, you don't! When you cancel your subscription, you keep your paid Plus features until the end of your current billing period. You can cancel by going to **Settings > Billing > Cancel plan**.
